Du bringst deine juristische Expertise direkt in den KI-Associate ein, arbeitest dafür eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam zusammen, begleitest Kanzleien bei der Einführung und übersetzt, was du im direkten Kontakt mit Kanzleien lernst, in konkrete Maßnahmen, die Adoption, Zufriedenheit und langfristigen Wert schaffen. Über 450 Anwaltskanzleien nutzen den KI-Associate täglich – damit sind wir eines der am schnellsten wachsenden LegalTech-Scaleups Deutschlands: Du baust daran von Anfang an mit. Deine Aufgaben Product & Legal AI Development – Du entwickelst Silvernova gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam juristisch-fachlich weiter: Konzeption, Validierung und Iteration agentischer Legal-AI-Workflows, Aufbau von Wissensmodellen und Qualitätssicherung der fachlichen Ergebnisse. Customer Enablement – Du begleitest unsere Kanzleien mit strukturierten Onboardings, Trainings und Best Practices, damit sie schnell produktiv werden und messbaren Mehrwert sehen. Fachlicher Content – Du erstellst Produktvideos, Best Practices und Enablement-Inhalte für bestehende und neue Rechtsgebiete und konzipierst Webinare, Events und Kampagnen, die den Mehrwert von Legal AI greifbar machen. Was du mitbringst Juristischer Hintergrund – abgeschlossenes Jurastudium, idealerweise 2. Staatsexamen und Anwaltszulassung. Zudem bist du gut organisiert, motiviert und musikbegeistert? Dann suchen wir dich. Was du machst  Du unterstützt uns bei der Organisation, Koordination und administrativen Umsetzung von Projekten und Prozessen. Mit deiner Hilfe stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Künstler:innen für die gewerbliche Nutzung ihrer Musik fair vergütet werden. Hierfür recherchierst du rechtliche und wirtschaftliche Sachverhalte und pflegst datenseitig verschiedene Tools und Systeme. jobs.title: Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA
jobs.description: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join The Cities team leads the work necessary to implement the regulatory products and processes needed globally to comply with regulations, and does so in a manner that also sustainably supports Airbnb s growth. Within Cities, this role owns Airbnb s platform regulatory compliance program across EMEA — the growing set of EU and UK obligations that sit alongside, and increasingly beyond, short-term rental regulation. The Difference You Will Make As Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA, you are the accountable owner for a portfolio of platform regulations that is expanding in scope, scrutiny, and consequence — including the Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act, and more. You will translate each obligation into a durable operating process, a defensible reporting methodology, or a product change — and serve as a trusted advisor to Legal, Policy, and Product leadership on how Airbnb meets its regulatory commitments in the region. A Typical Day:  Own the EMEA compliance portfolio. Establish the operating processes and documentation that sustain obligations at scale, and report and monitor status and risk. Deliver regulatory reporting and submissions. Own the annual and ad hoc reporting calendar end to end. Deliver against regulatory deadlines, and iterate so each cycle is faster and more defensible than the last. Assess obligations and strengthen assurance. Identify new and changing obligations early, evaluate our readiness against them, and recommend the measures required to meet them.  Translate regulatory requirements into scalable solutions. jobs.description: 📍 Remote / London Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We’re an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide. Content volume is rising fast, and automated detection handles a growing share of low-risk cases. The work that matters most is still human-led: high-risk decisions where context and judgement matter. You’ll report to our Moderation Manager as part of the Trust & Safety team. This is an overnight role: 2am to 9am UK time, Tuesday to Saturday. We’re fully remote. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. Position Summary The Compliance and Regulatory Counsel will act as a key legal partner to deliver and scale critical legal support to a growing global hi-tech SaaS company serving customers that include multi-national enterprises and public sector entities. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers.
